## Okanta Wasteland Shaman (CR 9)

**XP** 6,400  
Male okanta shaman (unsworn shaman) 10  
N Medium humanoid  
Init—1; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +10  

**Defense**

 **AC** 18, touch 9, flat-footed 18 (+5 armor, –1 Dex, +4 natural)  
**hp** 110 (10d8+30)  
**Fort** +4, **Ref** +2, **Will** +13; +2 vs. fear  
**Defensive Abilities** fearless  
**Weaknesses** light sensitivity  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft. (20 ft. in armor)  
**Melee** gore +8 (1d6+1)  
**Special Attacks** minor spirit hexes (arcane enlightenment, benefit of wisdom, healing)  
**Shaman Spells Prepared** (CL 10th; concentration +14)  

 5th—control winds (DC 19), flame strike (DC 19); righteous might  
4th—cure critical wounds (DC 18), divine power, poison (DC 18), restoration; wall of fire<sup>S</sup> (DC 18)  
3rd—call lightning (DC 17), remove disease, speak with dead (DC 17), wind wall; fireball<sup>S</sup> (DC 17)  
2nd—augury, barkskin, flame blade, inflict moderate wounds (DC 16), summon swarm; resist energy<sup>S</sup>  
1st—cure light wounds (DC 15), gentle breeze, mindlink, sleep (DC 15), stone shield; enlarge person<sup>S</sup> (DC 15)  
0 (at will)—create water, know direction, light, purify food and drink (DC 14)  

 <sup>S</sup> spirit magic spell  

**Tactics**

 **Before Combat** A wasteland shaman casts barkskin before combat.  

 **During Combat** Most wasteland shamans don’t seek out combat and attempt to defuse hostile encounters with a mixture of diversionary tactics such as control winds and wall of fire and, if pressed, outright violence by way of flame strike and fireball.  

 **Morale** A wasteland shaman will attempt to negotiate to end a conflict if reduced to half hit points or less, or will attempt to flee by means of a scroll of fly.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 12, **Dex** 8, **Con** 13, **Int** 10, **Wis** 18, **Cha** 15  
**Base Atk** +7; **CMB** +9; **CMD** 18  
**Feats** Accursed Hex, Combat Casting, Iron Will, Skill Focus (Perception), Toughness  
**Skills** Acrobatics –2 (–6 to jump), Diplomacy +10, Heal +16, Knowledge (nature) +12, Perception +10, Sense Motive +9, Spellcraft +12, Survival +17  
**Languages** Common, Okanta  
**SQ** adaptive mimicry, battle spirit, powerful build, spirit animal, touch of flame  
**Combat Gear** potion of cure light wounds, potion of cure moderate wounds (2), scroll of fly, staff of blessed relief (43 charges), healer’s kit; **Other Gear**+1 armored coat, greater aetheric capacitor (545 au)
